title: BECE Business Studies: Office Practice - Business Studies - The Office
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A place where administrative and clerical duties are performed to achieve the objectives of an organization is referred to as an
questions.explain: An **office** is formally defined as a place, room, or building where administrative, clerical, and information-handling duties are carried out to achieve organizational goals.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: According to structural size and capacity, the two main types of offices are
questions.explain: The basic classification of offices based on size and operational scale highlights two main types: **Small office** and **Large office**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An office that is typically run by a sole proprietor with very few clerical staff and a simple structure is a
questions.explain: A **small office** is usually characterized by few employees, less floor space, and a simple management structure (often run by a sole proprietor).
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is a core clerical function of an office?
questions.explain: The primary functions of an office revolve around information management, which includes **receiving, recording, and processing information**. Manufacturing, construction, and transport are operational/industrial activities.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The following are administrative functions of an office EXCEPT
questions.explain: Processing information, giving out information, and safeguarding assets are core office functions. **Cultivating agricultural products** belongs to the primary (extractive) industry, not office work.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A multinational corporation with hundreds of employees divided into specialized departments operates a
questions.explain: A **large office** handles a vast volume of work, requires division into specialized departments, and employs many workers.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The division of a large organization into various distinct offices or departments is primarily intended to
options: ensure efficiency and division of labour
questions.explain: Different offices (like Accounting, Sales, Personnel) exist within a large organization to promote **specialization, division of labour, and overall efficiency**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When an office sends out invoices, receipts, and circulars to its customers, it is performing the function of
questions.explain: Disseminating documents such as letters, receipts, and invoices to external parties is the practical application of the office function known as **giving out information**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Keeping vital company documents in fireproof safes and maintaining backups of computer files is an office function known as
questions.explain: An office must protect its physical items (cash, equipment) and its intangible assets (data, documents). Doing so using safes or digital backups fulfills the function of **safeguarding assets and records**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In a typical large organization, the specific office responsible for keeping financial records and paying salaries is the
questions.explain: The **Accounting (or Accounts) office** is the distinct office in an organization designated for managing money, recording financial transactions, and processing staff payroll.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An office is best described not just as a physical room, but fundamentally as a centre for
questions.explain: While an office is a physical space, its operational meaning in business is a central hub for **communication, correspondence, and information management**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Sorting, collating, calculating, and analyzing data to make it useful for management decisions is referred to as
questions.explain: When raw data is manipulated—such as through sorting, calculating, or summarizing—so it can be used for decision making, this specific office function is termed **processing information**.
questions.subject: Business Studies
